text: Cream is added to the milk before it sets, giving at least 72% fat in the dry matter, a triple-cream cheese with a fine paste tasting of cream and fresh butter. The long, cool lactic set gives a mildly acid taste, and only the 'affiné' version grows a white bloomy rind.

steps.note: The milk is enriched with cow's cream before it sets.
The curd drains by its own weight, without pressing, and is moulded into cylinders of 100–250 g or 500 g and more, at a pH of 4.9 or less.
The cheese may be salted on one face only.
The matured version, called affiné, is the only one ripened for at least 5 days if small or 8 if large; the fresh one is sold from day 3.
